item.title: Bikini Junkie

  • 日本語名: ビキニ・ジャンキー
  • 英語名: Bikini Junkie

あらすじ

The main character loves women in bikinis.

If he’s a bad guy, he’ll be drooling over them!

But ……

I don’t have a girlfriend!

I was living a dreary life.

One summer day, he received a call from his cousin Tomoe.

The café she manages is opening a second location for the summer, and she asks if she would like to work there as a part-time worker.

item.title: Café Junkie
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Blue Gale ON DEMAND
  • 発売日: 2007-03-02
  • スコア: 6.74/10 (21 人評価)
  • 日本語名: カフェ・ジャンキー
  • 英語名: Café Junkie

あらすじ

Even though Masaru is about to graduate from a technical college he still has no job. His one and only pleasure is to spend time at a cafe called “Hidamari.” The cafe is owned by his childhood friends Nanami and Kurumi’s parents and they are working there too. One day, he learns another one of his childhood friends is coming back to his town. He says, “I wanna meet her soon.” Triggered by his words, Nanami and Kurumi starts to approach him in a very different way than they ever did before….
